tasks.title: Place ThemeToggle in the 404 header and verify dark contrast
acceptance_criteria: ThemeToggle is imported and rendered in the 404 page header, right-aligned (header already uses justify-content: space-between).
The page still reads its colors from HF.* (var(--c-*)) so it renders dark automatically under data-theme="dark"; no hard-coded colors are introduced.
Header layout stays intact; the toggle sits opposite the title.
tests: NotFoundPage renders a theme toggle button in its header
NotFoundPage still renders the 404 heading and the back button
